name: @salon/site
description: Public barber demo site (L1-L9) + chat widget + embeddable snippet. Deploys to Vercel. Contains NO dashboard code and NO Airtable access — that separation is the point (Phase 6 decision D-1). NOTE: `prebuild` builds the SNIPPET too. public/barber-widget.js is a gitignored build artefact, so a deployment that ran only `next build` shipped a site whose one-line embed 404s — the template's single promise, broken by a missing build step (Codex CRT #13, finding 4).
